page_title: LEC 2-1 LAZ | Lecce v Lazio 20/08/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+4' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Luca Pellegrini (Lazio) was quite harsh and Federico Dionisi didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
90+4' Taty Castellanos (Lazio) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball away to eliminate the danger.
90+2' The up-to-date shots on target statistics – 7:4.
90' We will have 6 min. of added time.
88' Maurizio Sarri has decided to substitute Danilo Cataldi and he is replaced by Taty Castellanos (Lazio).

87' 2 - 1 Goal! Federico Di Francesco (Lecce) picks up the ball from a rebound and from the edge of the box he unleashes a low shot into the bottom left corner. Ivan Provedel is unable to keep the ball out of the net. It's 2:1.
85' 1 - 1 Goal! Pontus Almqvist (Lecce) collects a pass and without hesitation fires an unstoppable shot inside the left post.
83' A substitution has been made. Joan Gonzalez goes off and Rares Burnete (Lecce) comes on.
82' Ciro Immobile (Lazio) came close to scoring but should have done much better. His poor attempt from close range ended up in the gloves of Wladimiro Falcone.
80' Marin Pongracic (Lecce) goes into the book for a horrible tackle. A yellow card is necessary in this case.
80' Joan Gonzalez (Lecce) has tested the patience of referee Federico Dionisi and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
77' Substitution. Lameck Banda is replaced by Federico Di Francesco (Lecce).
75' Pontus Almqvist (Lecce) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away.
72' Substitution. Mattia Zaccagni will be replaced by Pedro (Lazio).
72' Here is a change. Manuel Lazzari is going off and Maurizio Sarri gives the last tactical orders to Luca Pellegrini (Lazio).
71' Federico Dionisi shows a yellow card to Gustav Isaksen (Lazio) for his blatant foul.
68' Gabriel Strefezza (Lecce) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Federico Dionisi had an easy-decision to make.
65' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Mohamed Kaba (Lecce) will replace Hamza Rafia.
65' Roberto D'Aversa prepares a substitution. Valentin Gendrey is replaced by Alexis Blin (Lecce).
65' That's the end of the game for Patrick Dorgu, who is replaced by Antonino Gallo (Lecce).
64' None of the Lazio players could reach the corner kick as the ball was overhit and goes out of play.
62' Lecce have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
61' The resulting set piece from Lazio is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
61' Manuel Lazzari (Lazio) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it.
59' Valentin Gendrey (Lecce) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat.
57' Patrick Dorgu (Lecce) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear.
54' Maurizio Sarri decides to make a substitution. Felipe Anderson will be replaced by Gustav Isaksen (Lazio).
54' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Matias Vecino (Lazio) comes onto the pitch so that Daichi Kamada can be given a rest.
54' Felipe Anderson (Lazio) takes a short pass in his stride and attempts to beat the keeper from mid-range, but the shot screeches just wide of the right post.
53' Marin Pongracic (Lecce) commits a rough challenge and Federico Dionisi blows his whistle for an infringement.
51' Gabriel Strefezza (Lecce) shoots from the edge of the penalty area. The ball travels low towards the middle of the target, but Ivan Provedel easily deals with the threat.
50' Pontus Almqvist (Lecce) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence.
48' Ylber Ramadani (Lecce) spanks one well wide of the left post from the edge of the box.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+2' The match has reached half-time.
45' 1 additional min. will be played.
45' The corner is swung in but Lecce can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
43' Ylber Ramadani (Lecce) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being blocked by one of the defenders.
42' A cross from a corner kick by Lecce is too strong and the ball goes well out of play.
42' Lecce failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat. The ball goes out of play and Lecce have been awarded a corner kick.

41' Hamza Rafia (Lecce) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Lecce.
39' Ciro Immobile (Lazio) is first to the rebound inside the box but sends his effort high over the bar.
37' Ciro Immobile (Lazio) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
35' Patrick Dorgu (Lecce) sends a pass into the penalty area, but the opponent manages to cut it out.
33' Pontus Almqvist (Lecce) strikes the ball towards goal, but it fails to reach the target after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
31' Patrick Dorgu (Lecce) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked.
28' It looks like Gabriel Strefezza (Lecce) saw red with that tackle. Federico Dionisi won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul.
26' 0 - 1 GOAL - 0:1! Luis Alberto found Ciro Immobile (Lazio) inside the box, he spotted goalkeeper Wladimiro Falcone off his line and chipped the ball into the net. What a cheeky lob!
25' Hamza Rafia (Lecce) commits a foul after unfairly pressing his opponent during an attacking move.
24' Daichi Kamada (Lazio) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Federico Dionisi blows for a foul.
22' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Patrick Dorgu (Lecce).
19' Felipe Anderson (Lazio) found some space to play in a lofted pass, but he looks disappointed as none of his teammates managed to connect with it.
17' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Lecce comes to nothing.
15' Hamza Rafia (Lecce) attempts to slip the ball through the defence, but is unable to find any of his teammates.
13' A weak shot from the edge of the box by Lameck Banda (Lecce) is easily saved by Ivan Provedel.
11' Luis Alberto (Lazio) tries to play a through ball from just inside the box to Ciro Immobile, but one of the defending players is alert to the danger and makes a timely interception.
10' Dangerous play by Adam Marusic (Lazio). Federico Dionisi blows his whistle for a foul.
8' Joan Gonzalez (Lecce) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
5' Lameck Banda (Lecce) commits a minor foul to interrupt the attacking move of his opponent and is warned by the referee that he will get a yellow card if he does it again.
4' Daichi Kamada (Lazio) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence.

2' Long passes, short passes and one-two passes. Lazio are showcasing great team work by keeping possession and producing pin-point passes from player to player. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult to intercept at the moment.
1' The first half has just begun.
Lazio will kick-off.
Federico Dionisi will supervise the game today.
Show lineups The starting lineups of both teams are already revealed and you can check them out in the details of this match.
